SITE INFORMATION

Privacy Policy

What happens to the numbers you enter and the information involved in visiting this website.

Last updated: September 24, 2026

The numbers you enter into the calculator are processed in your browser. The site does not send your list of numbers to a server.

Calculator input

Your entries and results remain in the open page on your device. We do not require an account, store your calculation history, or receive the list you type. The “Copy total” button uses your browser’s clipboard feature only when you select it. Closing or reloading the page clears your entries.

Website visits

Like other websites, the hosting and security services that deliver this site may process technical information needed to serve pages and protect the service. This may include your IP address, request time, browser details, and requested page. When this site is hosted by Cloudflare, Cloudflare may process that information under its own privacy policy. This information is separate from the numbers you enter into the calculator.

Cookies and analytics

The site code does not set cookies, include advertising trackers, or run analytics scripts. If these practices change, we will update this policy before or when the change is introduced.

External links

This site may link to websites operated by others. Their privacy practices are governed by their own policies.

Changes to this policy

We may update this page as the site evolves. The date above shows when it was last revised. Please review it when you return if you want to know the current practices.

Questions

For privacy questions, write to privacy@sumcalculator.net.
